tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Midnight. The one main action per view on light grounds (n-btn-primary), the featured pricing border, the input focus border, n-badge-midnight, focus ring on light grounds. White text 14.3:1. Never body text or large backgrounds; on brand-navy use brass instead.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of n-btn-primary.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest midnight for emphasis where primary needs more weight.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary (14.3:1), oxblood (9:1) and brand-navy fills.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Hero band and other dark grounds. Carries on-dark (17.5:1), on-dark-muted (8.3:1) and brass (5.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper navy for promo banners on dark pages.

tokens.name: brand-navy-mid
tokens.usage: Mid navy for layering inside navy bands.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The signature accent. Deco double rule under display titles, meter fills, the brass CTA on navy (n-btn-brass, on-brass text 5.7:1), n-badge-brass, illustration. Never text on light grounds (2.9:1): use brass-deep.

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: Brass-family text: on canvas (6.1:1) and on card-tint-champagne (5:1), n-tag-brass.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on brass fills (5.7:1).

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Second accent, used sparingly: n-badge-oxblood (white 9:1), oxblood text on card-tint-blush (6.9:1), illustration.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Green-family text on card-tint-sage (6.8:1), n-tag-sage.

tokens.name: link-blue
tokens.usage: Inline text links and n-btn-link only (6.8:1 on canvas, 6:1 on surface). Never a CTA fill; never mixed with primary.

tokens.name: link-blue-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of link-blue.

tokens.name: card-tint-champagne
tokens.usage: Feature card and job-card cover ground; n-tag-brass fill. Charcoal text 11.6:1.

tokens.name: card-tint-blush
tokens.usage: Feature card and cover ground; n-tag-oxblood fill. Charcoal text.

tokens.name: card-tint-sage
tokens.usage: Feature card and cover ground; n-tag-sage fill. Charcoal text.

tokens.name: card-tint-mist
tokens.usage: Feature card and cover ground; n-tag-mist fill (primary text 11:1). Charcoal text.

tokens.name: card-tint-powder
tokens.usage: Feature card and cover ground. Charcoal text.

tokens.name: card-tint-cream
tokens.usage: Feature card ground. Charcoal text.

tokens.name: card-tint-brass
tokens.usage: The one high-emphasis banner per page (n-tint-brass). Charcoal text 10:1.

tokens.name: card-tint-stone
tokens.usage: Neutral tinted ground; n-tag-gray fill (slate text 5.9:1).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ivory. Card, input, table and footer surface, and the page ground of marketing pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Warm parchment. App screen grounds, section bands, search field, featured pricing tier, stat row, CTA banner, promo banner. Ink, charcoal, slate and steel all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quieter section divisions.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards, tables, nav and footer; the disabled button fill and meter track. Decorative: it separates, it does not carry meaning.

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Quieter dividers between table and list rows.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: 1px border on text inputs and n-btn-secondary: 3.1:1 on canvas, so controls are findable by their border.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Near-black: the active pill-tab fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas (17.9:1) and surface (15.4:1); text on n-btn-on-dark.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Body emphasis on canvas and the text colour on every card-tint ground (10:1 or better).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas (7:1), surface (6.2:1) and card-tint-stone (5.9:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: footer links, inactive tabs, placeholders, eyebrows. 5.8:1 on canvas, 5.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Decorative only (icons beside a label, separators): below 4.5:1 for text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders in disabled controls (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and focus ring on brand-navy (17.5:1) and on the active pill tab.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and outlined-button border on brand-navy (8.3:1).

tokens.name: semantic-success
tokens.usage: Confirmation green, 6.2:1 on canvas. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: semantic-warning
tokens.usage: Mid-priority alerts (amber-brown), 5.8:1 on canvas. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: semantic-error
tokens.usage: Validation errors (garnet), 7.2:1 on canvas. Always pair with the message text.

families.sans: "Albert Sans", "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans-sc: "Albert Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: Federo, "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif
families.display-sc: Federo, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: Display face, used sparingly: the marketing tagline only, centred on brand-navy. Steps down 72/56/48/36px at narrower breakpoints. Use with .n-display so Chinese gets Noto Sans Regular with 0.06em tracking.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: Display face: the one big page title at the top of each app screen (Discover, Track, Profile). Never inside cards or lists. Use with .n-display.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Marketing section openers. Base face, not display.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page-level marketing headlines. Base face, not display.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary body, table cells, footer links.

styles.name: micro-uppercase
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above headings. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Footer-link vertical padding, tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Pill-tab vertical padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Input and search-pill vertical padding, promo-banner padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, comparison-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Template card padding, comparison-row horizontal padding, logo-wall cells.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: card-base, agent tile, startup perk and FAQ item padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Feature, pricing and testimonial card padding; container gutters.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Large in-section gaps.

tokens.name: space-section-sm
tokens.usage: stat-row padding.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Pricing-page section rhythm; cta-banner-light and footer padding.

tokens.name: space-section-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing-page section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-hero
tokens.usage: hero-band-dark padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tag chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Type badges (badge-tag-*), button-ghost.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every button, inputs, search-pill, comparison table, FAQ item. Buttons are rectangles, never pills.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: All card families, pricing tiers, workspace mockup, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Larger feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: Featured product showcases.

tokens.name: radius-xxxl
tokens.usage: Larger feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges and pill tabs only, never regular buttons.

shadow.note: Elevation levels 0-4. Level 0 is flat: no shadow, a hairline border.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Subtle lift on elevated tiles.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Feature cards that need lift.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: The hero product mockup against brand-navy only.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Modals and dropdowns.

tokens.name: bp-mobile-lg
tokens.usage: From here: feature cards 2-up, hero 48px.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: 2-column feature grids, hero 56px, footer 3 columns.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here: full top nav (hamburger below), 4-tier pricing row, hero 72px.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: From here: full 80px hero. Also the container max-width.
